title: Senior Software Engineer - Python
description:
**About Ottimate:**


Ottimate helps fast\-growing businesses automate Accounts Payable (AP) on their terms. We simplify everything from invoice management to payments for both recurring and one\-off expenses with a cloud\-first approach. Ottimate's AI\-native AP Automation and VendorPay Network helps businesses pay and get paid faster.


At Ottimate, passion generates excitement for what we do and how we do it. With passion at the heart of everything we do, we nurture ideas, inspire excellence, and find creative ways to eliminate obstacles for cultivating growth. The positive attitude with which we assist one another develops open, honest, and genuine connections. Above all, we celebrate and embrace our differences. We invest in each other because we win or lose as a team.


Our values are at the center of our company and culture. At Ottimate, we value: Growth, Customer Focus, Innovation, Accountability, and Communication.

**The Role:**


Ottimate's mission is to make accounts payables and payments effortless for businesses. We are looking for a Backend Engineer to contribute to our new product efforts and help us take ideas to market. Our stack is based on Django, Angular, Postgres, and AWS. Expertise in Django is must. Planning, shipping, and learning are the most important traits we are looking for.

 **Requirements** **You will:**


Discuss, plan, build and test new features.


Bring in learnings from your previous roles and experiences to help build exciting new fintech innovations for businesses everywhere


Collaborate with engineers, designers, product managers, and other stakeholders in defining the user experience.


Triage and fix bugs, often working directly with users.


Manage code reviews through Pull Requests and make sure we're moving fast while maintaining Unit Tests and quality.


Help migrate some of the modules into independent micro\-services.


Work on product features that affect 10s of thousands of customers.

**Skills and Experience:**


3\+ years of professional experience working on web applications using modern software engineering processes.


Proficient in Python and Django.


Debugging complex database performance issues.


You think critically about your work and ask questions in order to improve the product, not only on its technical implementation but also on how well it’s serving the users' needs.


You have built performant and scalable backends, made pragmatic tradeoffs, and can point to your prior work.


You have strong communication skills and are able to explain complex technical topics to the entire team in a clear and concise way.


When things inevitably break, you eagerly jump in to diagnose and fix the core issues.


Experience working in an early\-stage startup is a huge plus.

**Nice to haves:**


Fintech / Accounting experience.


ERP / Accounting Systems integrations experience.


Exposure to Purchase Orders


AWS DevOps

title: Software Quality Engineer – Automation & AI
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  

  

  

**Group/Division**

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high\-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Film and Scatterometry Technology (FaST) division delivers industry\-leading metrology solutions essential to advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its portfolio includes systems for measuring film thickness, critical dimensions, composition, and resistivity—key to developing and scaling next\-gen IC processes. FaST partners closely with customers from early R\&D through high\-volume production, ensuring performance and process alignment.
**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high\-impact work across your area of expertise.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Qualify new and existing software products and features through functional, regression, performance, reliability, and system\-level testing.
* Design, develop, and execute test plans, test cases, and validation strategies to ensure high product quality.
* Analyze test results and publish qualification reports, recommendations, training materials, and Best Known Methods (BKMs).
* Collaborate with Algorithm, System Engineering, Applications Engineering, Product Management, Manufacturing, Marketing, and Customer Support teams across global locations.
* Assess automation feasibility and develop automated test solutions, frameworks, and tools to improve test coverage and efficiency.
* Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design reviews, deployment, troubleshooting, and customer support.

**AI \& Innovation Responsibilities**

* Leverage Generative AI and AI\-powered tools to improve test design, execution, defect analysis, reporting, and documentation.
* Develop AI\-enabled utilities, applications, and productivity tools for engineering and quality workflows.
* Explore and implement solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, and modern AI frameworks.
* Drive AI adoption within the SQE organization by identifying, prototyping, and deploying high\-impact use cases.
* Utilize AI and data analytics techniques to improve quality insights, root cause analysis, and engineering productivity.

**Desired Skills**

* Develop Python\-based solutions for build orchestration, deployment automation, and API integrations with DevOps and SCM platforms

What makes you a great fit

  

Above all, you're a seasoned integration engineer with deep CI/CD expertise, a DevOps\-first mindset, and the ability to drive standardization and automation across multiple embedded software teams. We'd also imagine that you are/have:

  

* 9\+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Build Engineering, DevOps, or CI/CD Automation with proven experience designing pipelines from scratch
* Strong experience supporting Embedded C software development environments including cross\-compilation, toolchain management, and firmware deployment
* Hands\-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and implementing DevSecOps practices including software supply chain security

It's a plus if you also:

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:

Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

 **Role Summary**


The Principal Software Engineer is a senior individual\-contributor and enterprise technical leader responsible for shaping architecture, driving hands\-on execution, and elevating engineering practices across multiple teams. This role leads the design and delivery of secure, scalable, resilient and high\-performing software, data and AI solutions while translating complex business needs into simple, extensible technical approaches.

  

The role combines deep expertise in modern application engineering, cloud platforms, data engineering and AI with broad organizational influence. The Principal Software Engineer partners with engineering, product, architecture, data science and business leaders; mentors engineers and technical leaders; and accelerates the responsible adoption of Generative AI, Agentic AI and intelligent automation.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* AI\-First Technical Leadership
	+ Provide technical leadership for AI\-powered products, copilots, agent\-based systems and intelligent workflows, from architecture through production operation
	+ Design practical solutions using Azure AI Foundry, GPT models, RAG architectures, vector search, knowledge graphs and agent orchestration frameworks where they create measurable value
	+ Establish reusable engineering patterns for prompt design, model evaluation, grounding, observability, guardrails, security, privacy and Responsible AI
	+ Champion the effective use of AI\-assisted engineering workflows to improve software design, development, testing, documentation, operations and analytics
	+ Evaluate emerging capabilities across Generative AI, multimodal AI, Agentic AI and LLMOps, and translate relevant advances into secure enterprise solutions
* Architecture and Solution Design
	+ Lead the architecture, design and evolution of complex, business\-critical systems across application, cloud, data and AI domains
	+ Decompose complex business and technical problems into clear, maintainable and extensible architectures with well\-defined boundaries and interfaces
	+ Design distributed, cloud\-native solutions using microservices, event\-driven patterns, RESTful APIs, containers, serverless services and platform capabilities
	+ Assess system interdependencies, scalability, reliability, performance, security, data quality and long\-term maintainability when making design decisions
	+ Define technical strategies and reference architectures that align product roadmaps with enterprise standards and modernization priorities
* Technical Execution and Innovation
	+ Remain sufficiently hands\-on to create prototypes, validate architectural choices, resolve critical technical challenges and guide implementation quality
	+ Drive engineering solutions across NET/C\#, React/TypeScript, Python and Scala, selecting technologies based on product and platform needs
	+ Guide the design of data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes and analytical solutions using Azure Databricks, Apache Spark and modern lakehouse patterns
	+ Lead performance engineering for high\-volume systems, including database design, query optimization, throughput, latency and resource efficiency
	+ Create reusable frameworks, accelerators and engineering assets, and contribute to patents, publications or other intellectual property where appropriate
* Engineering Excellence and Operational Readiness
	+ Drive adoption of CI/CD, automated testing, Infrastructure as Code, containerization, observability and secure development lifecycle practices
	+ Ensure production solutions meet expectations for availability, resilience, recoverability, supportability, compliance and data governance
	+ Guide MLOps and LLMOps practices for versioning, deployment, evaluation, monitoring and lifecycle management of models and AI applications
	+ Use architecture reviews, technical quality measures and operational feedback to identify systemic risks and improve engineering outcomes
	+ Promote root\-cause analysis and durable corrective actions for complex production and platform issues
* Mentorship and Organizational Influence
	+ Mentor senior engineers, architects and emerging technical leaders through design reviews, pairing, coaching and technical forums
	+ Influence engineering standards and roadmaps across multiple teams without relying on direct authority
	+ Build alignment across product, engineering, architecture, data science, security and business stakeholders on key technical decisions
	+ Communicate complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including trade\-offs, risks and recommended decisions
	+ Foster a culture of continuous learning, experimentation, inclusion, accountability and engineering excellence
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

 **Required Qualifications:**

* Experience
	+ Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience
	+ 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including demonstrated leadership in the design and delivery of large\-scale, complex systems
	+ Proven experience operating as a senior technical leader across multiple teams, products or platforms
	+ Hands\-on experience delivering cloud\-native, data\-intensive or AI\-enabled enterprise solutions into production
	+ Demonstrated ability to influence technical strategy, resolve ambiguity and drive decisions across organizational boundaries
* Core Technical Expertise
	+ Data engineering: Experience designing ETL/ELT pipelines and large\-scale data processing solutions using Databricks, Spark, SQL and lakehouse or enterprise data platforms
	+ DevOps and platform practices: Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or Jenkins; Terraform or ARM/Bicep; Docker; Kubernetes; automated testing and observability
	+ AI engineering: Experience building or integrating AI\-powered applications using LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG, agentic patterns, model evaluation and production guardrails
	+ Cloud engineering: Extensive hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including compute, integration, data, identity, container and serverless services
	+ Application engineering: Deep expertise in multiple programming languages, with solid experience in NET/C\#, React with JavaScript or TypeScript, Python and/or Scala
	+ Architecture: Solid knowledge of distributed systems, microservices, event\-driven architecture, API design, domain\-driven design, design patterns and SOLID principles
	+ Security and governance: Solid understanding of threat modeling, identity and access management, privacy, secure development lifecycle and enterprise compliance expectations
	+ Databases: Solid proficiency in relational database design, SQL performance tuning and data modeling; working knowledge of NoSQL and vector data stores
* Leadership Capabilities:
	+ Proven exceptional systems thinking, problem\-solving and analytical judgment
	+ Proven solid mentoring, facilitation, written communication and executive\-level presentation skills
	+ Proven curiosity and continuous\-learning mindset across software, cloud, data and AI technologies
	+ Proven ability to balance strategic architecture with pragmatic delivery and measurable outcomes
	+ Proven ability to influence without authority, navigate disagreement and build durable technical consensus

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Production experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, MLflow, Azure Machine Learning or comparable AI platforms
* Experience with knowledge graphs, vector databases, multimodal AI, agent orchestration and decision\-intelligence solutions
* Deep expertise in advanced Azure services such as Azure Kubernetes Service, Cosmos DB, Event Hubs, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Data Factory or Synapse
* Experience with AWS or Google Cloud Platform in addition to Azure
* Experience designing real\-time or high\-traffic systems with demanding latency and throughput requirements

title: Senior Software Engineer-Systems
description:
**About Rocketlane**


Rocketlane is a fast\-growing, innovative SaaS company making waves in customer onboarding and professional services automation.


Our mission? To empower B2B companies with a smooth, consistent, and efficient way to onboard customers and manage client projects—reducing chaos and boosting customer satisfaction across industries.


We’re a close\-knit team of close 200 passionate professionals, all focused on building a product that teams love to use. Our journey has been fueled by $45M in funding from top investors, including 8VC, Matrix Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners.


**What will you do?**


We're looking for a **self\-motivated**, **enthusiastic**, and **hands\-on engineer** to set up solid DevOps and SRE foundations. If you thrive in a small, high\-energy team and want to play a key role in shaping infrastructure and reliability at scale, this is the place for you.


We’re looking for a hands\-on engineer with **3–6 years of experience** who has a **solid grasp of cloud infrastructure**, a **strong foundation in Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**, and a keen eye for choosing the right tools for the job. You’ll help design, build, and scale resilient infrastructure for a fast\-growing, product\-driven team.


* Design, build, and manage cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like **Terraform, Ansible, Chef, or CloudFormation**.
* Champion observability by defining **SLIs, SLOs**, and building robust **monitoring, logging, and alerting systems** using tools like **Prometheus, Grafana**, and custom telemetry.
* Ensure **availability, scalability, and resilience** of our SaaS platform and platform services in production.
* Proven ability to **improve system observability** through the **design and instrumentation of system\-level metrics**, enhancing visibility into system health, performance, and bottlenecks.
* **Dive deep into complex system architectures** to solve critical performance and reliability challenges.
* Work with developers and product teams to **embed NFR (Non\-functional Requirements)** into every product and feature release.
* Conduct **root cause analysis** and system\-level debugging (primarily on **Linux**).
* Build and maintain **CI/CD pipelines**, automating deployments and infrastructure operations across environments.
* Scale infrastructure to meet growth needs while optimizing cost and performance.
* Take ownership of **incident response, on\-call rotations**, and blameless postmortems.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to drive technical and architectural decision
* Highly **self\-driven**, **accountable**, and eager to own initiatives end\-to\-end. Comfortable working in **startups or small teams**, where flexibility, speed, and autonomy are key. Strong **communication** and **cross\-team collaboration** skills.

**You should apply if**


* Proficient in at least one **programming language** — Python, Java, or similar.
* Demonstrated experience with **performance optimization**, **latency reduction**, and **scaling services**.
* Strong analytical skills for **incident debugging**, **log analysis**, and **system troubleshooting**.
* Understanding of **service\-level metrics** (SLIs, SLOs, error budgets) and how to operationalize them.
* Experience building **large\-scale, distributed, resilient systems**.
* Strong understanding of core infrastructure components such as load balancers, firewalls, and databases — including their internal workings and operational fundamentals.
* **Solid understanding of infrastructure cost management** — proactively identifies cost drivers, implements optimization strategies, and contributes to **cost reduction initiatives** without compromising reliability or performance.
* Familiarity with **on\-call responsibilities**, **incident management**, and **root cause analysis**.
* Strong experience with **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**: Terraform, Ansible, Chef, or CloudFormation and other orchestration tools
* **Ability to deep\-dive into third\-party or internal library codebases** to understand internal behavior, debug complex issues, and contribute insights or fixes when needed.
* Solid understanding of **cloud platforms** — preferably **AWS**, but Azure or GCP is also acceptable.

**Why join us?**


At Rocketlane, we’re all about building a great product and a great place to work. Here’s why you’ll actually look forward to Mondays:


* **Impact and ownership**: You won’t just be another cog in the machine; here, you’re more like a turbocharged engine part. Bring your ideas, make them happen.
* **Work with the best**: We’re a team of passionate, quirky, and ridiculously talented people. Come for the work, stay for the memes.
* **Celebrate wins**: Whether we’re hitting major milestones or celebrating new funding, we like to mix it up. From rap videos to team outings, we believe in celebrating big.
* **Learn and grow**: We’re all about learning—and we’re not just talking about the latest SaaS trends. You’ll grow your career, pick up new skills, and maybe even learn to love Excel (or at least tolerate it).
* **Flexibility and balance**: While we love collaborating in the office five days a week, we know everyone has their own rhythm. That’s why we offer flexibility around hours—so you can bring your best energy, whether you’re an early bird or a night owl. Pajamas optional (at least outside the office).

Job Description: Junior ERP Functional Consultant (2\-4 Years Experience)  

This job description is for a junior\-to\-mid\-level Functional Consultant focused on Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems. The ideal candidate will combine functional business process knowledge with technical proficiency in SQL, Stored Procedures, and Cloud fundamentals to support system implementations and optimizations.  

Summary  

We are seeking a motivated ERP Functional Consultant with 2 to 4 years of experience to join our Support / Implementation team. This role serves as a vital link between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring that ERP solutions are configured to meet operational requirements while leveraging modern cloud environments.  

Key Responsibilities  

Functional \& Consulting  

* Requirement Gathering: Interface with business users to document current (AS\-IS) and future\-state (TO\-BE) workflows within the ERP ecosystem.
* System Configuration: Execute functional setups and configurations within ERP modules based on validated business requirements.
* Gap Analysis: Identify discrepancies between standard ERP functionality and business needs, recommending solutions that prioritize standard features over heavy customization.
* Testing \& Quality Assurance: Create and perform Unit Testing, Integration Testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate system behavior.
* Documentation: Maintain essential project artifacts, including functional design specifications and configuration workbooks.


Technical \& Cloud Integration  

* Database Operations (SQL): Write and optimize complex SQL queries to extract data, troubleshoot application errors, and validate backend configurations.
* Logic Development: Utilize Stored Procedures and basic PL/SQL logic to support data transformations, custom validations, and interface development.
* Cloud Maintenance: Apply Cloud Basics to navigate cloud consoles, manage environment settings, and understand the architecture of SaaS/PaaS ERP deployments.
* Data Migration: Assist in the extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) of legacy data into the ERP system, ensuring high levels of data integrity.


Required Skills and Experience  

* Experience: 2 to 4 years of professional experience in ERP functional consulting, support, or implementation.
* ERP Domain Knowledge: Proven functional understanding of core business processes such as Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P), Order\-to\-Cash (O2C), or SCM in any major ERP (e.g., Oracle, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics).
* Database Proficiency:
* Advanced SQL skills, including the use of joins, subqueries, and analytical functions.
* Hands\-on experience developing and troubleshooting Stored Procedures.
* Cloud Literacy: Fundamental understanding of cloud computing concepts (e.g., identity management, environments/instances, and cloud storage).
* Tools: Familiarity with database management tools like SQL Developer, Toad, or similar IDEs.
* Soft Skills: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to communicate technical concepts to non\-technical business users.


Preferred Qualifications  

* Functional experience with any ERP.
* Technical proficiency in SQL and Stored procedures.
* Certification in a specific ERP cloud module or Cloud Infrastructure (e.g., AWS, Azure, or OCI).

	+ Configure and customize Guidewire applications (ClaimsCenter and PolicyCenter) to meet business requirements.

	+ Implement and configure screen changes, wizards, and workflows.
* **Integration:**
	+ Design, develop, and implement integrations between Guidewire and third\-party systems using web services (SOAP/REST), messaging queues, and other integration patterns.
	+ Configure and customize Guidewire's integration framework.
	+ Troubleshoot and resolve integration\-related issues.
	+ Experience with middleware technologies is a plus.

	+ Translate business needs into technical specifications and solution designs.
	+ Provide guidance and expertise on Guidewire best practices and solutioning.
	+ Participate in solution design sessions and technical workshops.

	+ Mentor junior developers and team members on Guidewire development and configuration.
	+ Contribute to code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.

	+ Possess a strong understanding of the Guidewire data model.
	+ Experience with data migration, data transformation, and data analysis within the Guidewire ecosystem.
	+ Knowledge of SQL and database concepts. Working knowledge on Cloud database (eg Snowflake) is added advantage.

* Hands\-on experience with integration technologies such as RESTful APIs, SOAP web services, and XML/JSON.
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast\-paced environment.
* Good hands on Database administration or development

* Knowledge of Guidewire DataHub and InfoCenter.
* Familiarity with Guidewire InsuranceSuite components beyond ClaimsCenter and PolicyCenter (e.g., BillingCenter).
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Familiarity with various insurance lines of business (e.g., Commercial Auto, Workers' Compensation, Property \& Casualty).

title: Software Quality Engineer
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  

  

  

**Group/Division**

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high\-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. KLA's Central Engineering organization is made up of nine Centers of Excellence (CoEs) spanning disciplines like automation, motion control, sensors, platform design, and packaging. Each CoE contributes not only technical deliverables but also deep expertise, best practices, and advanced tools that elevate both what we build—and how we build it.
**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high\-impact work across your area of expertise.

  

  

### **Role Overview**


We are looking for a passionate **Quality Engineer** with strong software development, automation, and AI skills. You will build frameworks, tools, and intelligent solutions that improve product testability, accelerate defect detection, and enable quality throughout the software development lifecycle.


### **Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for desktop, web, API, and system\-level testing.
* Develop reusable software tools, libraries, APIs, and utilities that improve testability and engineering productivity.
* Partner with developers to review designs, improve code testability, and drive Shift\-Left quality practices.
* Integrate automated validation and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines.
* Apply AI and intelligent algorithms to generate tests, analyze logs, identify failure patterns, and accelerate root cause analysis.
* Automate the collection, transformation, and reporting of test results and quality metrics.
* Build actionable dashboards using Power BI or similar reporting tools.
* Support DevOps, continuous testing, and release\-readiness initiatives.

### **Required Skills and Qualifications**


* Strong software development experience using **C\#, Java, Python, TypeScript, or a similar programming language** .
* Strong understanding of OOP, OOD, data structures, algorithms, design patterns, and clean coding practices.
* Experience developing automation frameworks, developer tools, APIs, libraries, or test infrastructure.
* Experience with UI automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, WinAppDriver, or Coded UI.
* Experience with API testing frameworks such as RestAssured, Postman, SoapUI, JUnit, or TestNG.
* Knowledge of REST, SOAP, XML, JSON, SQL, Git, and web\-service technologies.
* Experience integrating automated tests into Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar CI/CD platforms.
* Hands\-on exposure to **Generative AI, AI\-assisted coding, prompt engineering, LLM APIs, intelligent test generation, or log and failure analysis using AI** .
* Strong debugging, problem\-solving, and root cause analysis skills.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.

**Minimum Qualifications**

Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years


**About KLA**

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

title: Lead Software Engineer - Salesforce CPQ
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We are hiring a **Lead Software Engineer \- Salesforce CPQ** to deliver hands\-on Salesforce engineering, converting solution designs into robust implementations. You will steer CPQ configuration and ARM migration work while integrating Salesforce with ERP and other enterprise systems using REST and SOAP APIs.

**Responsibilities**

* Deliver complex Salesforce implementations across multiple clouds and external systems based on the agreed architecture
* Mentor developers by leading code reviews, reinforcing coding standards, and guiding technical execution
* Build and debug integrations between Salesforce and enterprise systems such as ERP and legacy databases using batch, near real\-time, and real\-time patterns
* Partner with business analysts and stakeholders to confirm requirements and align engineering deliverables to business outcomes
* Build REST and SOAP APIs in line with the defined API\-led integration strategy
* Support integration tools and middleware platforms used to connect business systems by configuring and troubleshooting them
* Enforce data integration and governance controls to preserve data quality and consistency during delivery
* Set up Salesforce CPQ features including product bundles, pricing rules, quote calculation logic, and approval workflows per documented business requirements
* Assist sales and finance teams throughout build and testing to validate the quote generation process
* Lead technical build and code review workshops and create artifacts such as data model documentation and integration build specs
* Own the lead engineer role for large\-scale data migration workstreams, managing the transition of complex datasets into Salesforce
* Create scalable, secure migration tooling and scripts for large data volumes while meeting security standards and platform limitations
* Drive data migration execution by coordinating profiling, cleansing, transformation mapping, and reconciliation
* Provide technical leadership on data handling practices, archival implementation, and master data management build activities
* Manage hands\-on release management tasks including deployments, environment management, and go\-live technical readiness for large\-scale programs

**Requirements**

* Extensive hands\-on Salesforce development experience with 8\-12 years in IT
* Advanced knowledge of Salesforce CPQ configuration such as product bundles, pricing rules, and approval workflows
* Hands\-on experience creating and debugging integrations via REST APIs, SOAP APIs, and middleware platforms
* Solid background in databases, integration middleware, and enterprise systems including ERP
* Proven leadership in engineering teams, including code reviews and enforcement of coding standards and best practices
* Strong experience with enterprise data migration activities including profiling, cleansing, transformation mapping, and reconciliation
* Demonstrated ability to build scalable and secure migration tooling and scripts for large data volumes
* Clear understanding of data governance controls that ensure data quality and consistency
* Working knowledge of master data management (MDM) build activities and archival implementation
* Experience coordinating release management work, including deployments and environment management
* Capability in performance tuning, running data migration scripts, and supporting release management for large\-scale programs

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Principal Engineer, AI Platform Software Architecture
description:
**Company:**
------------

Qualcomm India Private Limited
**Job Area:**
-------------

Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Software Engineering
**General Summary:**

At Qualcomm, you will join a global leader in semiconductor technology and help shape the future of AI at the edge. You will work alongside world\-class engineers, architects, and product leaders to define the software architecture that enables AI experiences across a diverse range of products, including wearables, smartphones, XR devices, automotive platforms, edge computing systems, and AI PCs.


The Core Platform Software Architecture team is seeking an experienced and highly influential Principal Engineer, AI Platform Software Architecture to drive the software and system architecture for next\-generation AI inferencing platforms. In this role, you will lead cross\-functional architectural initiatives spanning software, hardware, security, memory systems, and AI accelerators while helping shape the long\-term technology strategy for Qualcomm's AI platform roadmap.


**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 8\+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

OR
  

Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 7\+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
  

OR
  

PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 6\+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
  

  

* 4\+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C\+\+, Java, Python, etc.

The successful candidate will serve as a technical leader responsible for influencing software and silicon architecture decisions across multiple product lines and future generations of AI platforms.


\-


Key Responsibilities


* Define and drive the long\-term platform software architecture and technical strategy for AI inferencing across Qualcomm's portfolio of edge AI products, influencing technology investments and architectural decisions across multiple product generations.
* Lead cross\-functional architectural initiatives involving software, hardware, AI accelerator, security, and product teams to deliver scalable and differentiated AI platform solutions.
* Collaborate with product management, customers, and silicon architecture teams to understand emerging AI workloads, product requirements, and technology trends, and translate them into platform architecture and roadmap recommendations.
* Drive hardware/software co\-design and influence future platform capabilities through architectural analysis, technical proposals, and strategic technology planning.
* Lead system\-level architecture and engineering efforts spanning operating systems, AI runtimes, memory systems, virtualization, security, interconnects, and heterogeneous compute architectures.
* Evaluate architectural alternatives, perform tradeoff analysis, and develop architecture proposals and specifications that balance performance, power, scalability, security, and product requirements.
* Drive alignment across organizations through architecture reviews, technical leadership, and effective stakeholder engagement.
* Mentor and influence engineers and architects across the company while helping establish architectural best practices, technical standards, and long\-term technology direction.

\-


Preferred Qualifications


* 15\+ years of experience architecting complex embedded, platform, or systems software solutions.
* Demonstrated success driving architecture and technical strategy across multiple product generations and organizations.
* Strong experience in hardware/software interface design, system architecture, and end\-to\-end platform engineering.
* Deep expertise in several of the following areas:

o SoC and computer architecture


o ARM and RISC\-V architectures


o Linux kernel, operating systems, and device drivers


o Memory management and memory subsystem architecture


o DMA, IOMMU, and system interconnect technologies


o Virtualization and hypervisor technologies


o Security architecture, trusted execution environments, attestation, confidential computing, and model protection


o AI inferencing runtimes, frameworks, compilers, and software stacks


o Large Language Models (LLMs), Transformer architectures, and modern AI workloads


o Heterogeneous computing systems involving CPUs, GPUs, DSPs, NPUs, and dedicated AI accelerators


* Proven ability to influence senior technical leaders and drive consensus across geographically distributed teams.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and technical presentation skills.

**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


Discover Your Future in Credit Risk Technology
  

Build systems that shape credit decisions—at scale.
  

Join a fast\-moving Credit Risk Technology team where modern engineering, data, and AI come together to drive real\-world financial impact. We operate with a startup mindset—ownership, speed, and experimentation—within the rigor and responsibility of a global financial institution. You’ll help design and deliver mission\-critical platforms that support credit risk assessment, analytics, and decisioning across the firm.

  

  

**Job Overview**  



  

The Credit Risk Applications Technology Lead Analyst is a senior engineering leadership role focused on building and evolving modern, scalable platforms for credit risk management. You will lead application design and development while partnering closely with risk, data, and platform teams to deliver systems that are performant, resilient, and compliant.  



  

This role blends hands\-on development, system architecture, technical leadership, and AI\-enabled innovation, with a strong emphasis on microservices, cloud\-native design, and enterprise\-grade governance.  



  

**Key Responsibilities**


* Architect, design, and deliver scalable, Python\-based applications supporting credit risk analytics, workflows, and reporting.
* Partner with risk, product, and technology leadership to integrate platforms, identify enhancements, and enable new products and process improvements.
* Resolve high\-impact, complex initiatives through deep analysis of business processes, system flows, and industry standards.
* Ensure solutions adhere to enterprise architecture, data, security, and infrastructure blueprints.
* Establish and enforce engineering standards for coding, testing, CI/CD, debugging, and production readiness.
* Design and evolve microservices\-based architectures, ensuring scalability, resiliency, observability, and maintainability.
* Apply AI and GenAI capabilities to modernize workflows, automate analysis, and unlock new insights in credit risk.
* Serve as technical leader and mentor, coaching mid\-level engineers and analysts and allocating work as needed.
* Apply sound risk and control judgment, ensuring compliance with laws, regulations, and policies while safeguarding clients, data, and the firm.
  

  

**How You’ll Work**


* Operate with a startup mindset: ownership, bias for action, and pragmatic innovation.
* Deliver with enterprise discipline: stability, controls, transparency, and audit readiness.
* Balance experimentation with responsibility in a high\-trust, high\-impact environment.
* Adapt quickly as priorities change while maintaining long\-term system integrity.
  

  

**Core Technical Skills**


* 10–15 years of experience in application development or systems engineering within complex environments.
* Advanced proficiency in **Python and SQL**, with strong software engineering fundamentals.
* Hands\-on experience building **API\-driven services using FastAPI, Pydantic, and/or Django.**
* Proven expertise designing and implementing microservices architectures, including service decomposition, inter\-service communication, resiliency patterns, and observability.
* Strong experience with **Docker and Kubernetes**, deploying and operating containerized services in production.
* Deep understanding of **system architecture, data flows, and distributed systems.**
* Experience working in **Linux** environments, including shell scripting and operational troubleshooting.
* Strong track record implementing **unit testing, TDD, and automated quality controls.**
* Subject Matter Expert (SME) in at least one application, platform, or service domain.
  

  

**AI \& Modern Engineering Tools**


* Working knowledge of **large language models (LLMs)** and modern AI platforms from leading providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Meta.
* Experience designing or contributing to LLM\-enabled solutions (e.g., copilots, workflow automation, analytics augmentation).
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, model integration patterns, and AI governance considerations in enterprise environments.
* Exposure to modern “vibe coding” practices—leveraging AI\-assisted tooling to accelerate development, experimentation, and problem solving while maintaining engineering rigor.

Bonus / Differentiating Skills


* Experience with distributed data and compute platforms (e.g., Spark, PySpark, Hadoop, Hive).
* Hands\-on experience with graph databases, particularly Neo4j, for network, relationship, or dependency\-driven use cases.
* Background in credit risk, financial risk management, or banking platforms.
* Experience modernizing or decomposing legacy monolithic systems in large enterprises.
* Proven delivery of GenAI / AI\-driven solutions in regulated or large\-scale environments.

title: Java Developer
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


We are seeking a talented and motivated**Java Developer**to join our core engineering team. In this role, you will design, develop, test, and maintain robust, high\-performance, and scalable enterprise applications. You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams, including product managers, architects, UI/UX designers, and DevOps engineers, to deliver high\-quality software solutions that meet business requirements and technical standards.


**2\. Key Responsibilities**
----------------------------


**Software Design \& Development**
----------------------------------


* Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable, and testable Java/J2EE applications and microservices.
* Write clean, maintainable, efficient, and well\-documented code adhering to object\-oriented programming (OOP) principles and SOLID design patterns.
* Design and implement RESTful APIs, SOAP services, and event\-driven messaging systems.
* Optimize application performance, throughput, latency, and memory utilization.

**Architecture \& System Integration**
--------------------------------------


* Participate in architectural discussions and system design reviews.
* Integrate backend services with relational (e.g., PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL) and NoSQL (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis) databases.
* Integrate enterprise systems with message brokers (e.g., Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, IBM MQ).
* Ensure seamless integration with third\-party APIs and microservice ecosystems.

**Testing \& Quality Assurance**
--------------------------------


* Implement comprehensive automated unit and integration tests using frameworks such as JUnit, Mockito, and Testcontainers.
* Participate in peer code reviews to ensure adherence to software engineering standards, security practices, and quality metrics.
* Proactively identify bottlenecks, address bugs, and remediate security vulnerabilities.

**DevOps \& Deployment**
------------------------


* Collaborate with DevOps teams to design and optimize Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
* Package and deploy containerized applications using Docker and orchestrate them viaKubernetes/OpenShift.
* Monitor application health and system performance using observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Splunk).

**3\. Required Qualifications \& Skills**
-----------------------------------------


**Technical Skills**
--------------------


* **Core Java \& Frameworks:**
	+ Strong proficiency in Java (Java 11 / 17 / 21\) and Core Java concepts (Multithreading, Concurrency, Collections, Generics, Stream API).
	+ Hands\-on experience with Spring Framework ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, Spring Cloud).
* **Database Management \& ORM:**
	+ Solid understanding of relational database design, SQL indexing, and query optimization (PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MySQL).
	+ Experience with Object\-Relational Mapping (ORM) tools (Hibernate, JPA, MyBatis).
	+ Familiarity with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis) is a plus.
* **Microservices \& API Design:**
	+ Experience designing, securing, and implementing RESTful APIs (OpenAPI/Swagger) and Microservices architecture.
	+ Familiarity with API Gateways, Service Discovery, and Circuit Breaker patterns.
* **Messaging \& Event Streaming:**
	+ Experience with message queues and event streaming platforms such as Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, or ActiveMQ.
* **Build Tools \& Version Control:**
	+ Experience with build and dependency management tools (Maven, Gradle).
	+ Proficiency with Git and modern branching workflows (Gitflow, trunk\-based development).

**Professional \& Educational Qualifications**
----------------------------------------------


* **Education:**Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
* **Experience:**3\+ years of professional software development experience in Java\-based environments (Mid\-level) or 5\+ years (Senior\-level).
* **Problem Solving:**Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and algorithmic thinking capabilities.
* **Communication:**Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across distributed teams.

**4\. Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have Skills**
-----------------------------------------


* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform).
* Hands\-on experience with containerization (Docker) and container orchestration (Kubernetes, OpenShift).
* Knowledge of secure coding practices (OWASP Top 10\) and static analysis tools (SonarQube, Checkmarx).
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools (Jira, Confluence).
* Knowledge of reactive programming (Project Reactor, RxJava, Spring WebFlux) is an advantage.

Mobile and Web Development experience with Angular, Java \& Python is preferred.

title: Sr Principal Software Engineer - MAC
description:
**Role Summary::**


We are looking for a Sr Principal Software Engineer, Mac UI Engineer to lead the design and development of high\-quality, customer\-facing Mac desktop experiences. This is a senior individual contributor role for an engineer who combines deep technical expertise with strong product thinking, architectural judgment, and cross\-functional influence.


The ideal candidate brings strong proficiency in Swift, Objective\-C, and C/C\+\+, along with a proven ability to build polished, performant, and reliable Mac user interfaces at scale. This role requires close collaboration with product management, design, platform, and quality teams to deliver intuitive user experiences while driving sound engineering practices across the organization.


Experience using AI tools to improve engineering productivity, code quality, and development workflows is a strong plus.

**What You Will Do::**

* Architect, design, and develop modern Mac UI features for customer\-facing desktop applications
* Lead implementation of complex UI workflows using Swift, Objective\-C, and C/C\+\+
* Drive technical direction for Mac UI architecture, maintainability, scalability, and performance
* Partner with product managers, designers, backend engineers, and QA to translate product requirements into elegant user experiences
* Own critical technical decisions across the UI layer, including frameworks, patterns, integrations, and code quality standards
* Review code, provide technical guidance, and raise the engineering bar through strong design and implementation practices
* Mentor engineers through technical leadership, design reviews, and day\-to\-day collaboration while remaining hands\-on in development
* Troubleshoot complex production issues across UI, system integration, memory, performance, and stability areas
* Advocate for usability, accessibility, responsiveness, and consistency across the Mac user experience
* Contribute to continuous improvement in engineering workflows, release quality, and developer productivity
* Evaluate and apply AI\-assisted development tools where they can improve speed, quality, or team effectiveness

**Required Qualifications::**

* 10\+ years of experience with Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Extensive software engineering experience with significant hands\-on development in Mac application engineering
* Strong proficiency in Swift, Objective\-C, and C/C\+\+
* Deep experience building native Mac UI applications and shipping customer\-facing desktop products
* Strong understanding of macOS application architecture, UI frameworks, event\-driven programming, and system\-level behavior
* Proven experience designing scalable, maintainable, and performant software systems
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills across UI, application, and platform layers
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction across teams without direct people management responsibility
* Experience working in cross\-functional product development environments
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs clearly to engineering and non\-engineering stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications::**

* Experience modernizing legacy Mac codebases and evolving mixed\-language applications
* Experience integrating UI layers with platform services, local system components, or shared libraries
* Familiarity with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and release engineering for desktop applications
* Strong understanding of software quality, security, performance optimization, and observability
* Experience partnering closely with UX and product teams to refine customer journeys and interaction design
* Experience using AI tools for coding assistance, test generation, code review acceleration, documentation, or developer workflow improvement
* Exposure to AI\-powered product features, assistant workflows, or developer tooling is a plus

**Leadership Expectations::**

* Operate as a senior technical leader and trusted expert for Mac UI engineering
* Balance hands\-on execution with architectural ownership and long\-term technical stewardship
* Influence engineering practices, design quality, and delivery outcomes across multiple teams
* Bring a strong product mindset and make decisions that improve customer experience as well as engineering health
* Raise the standard for code quality, design reviews, technical decision\-making, and cross\-team collaboration

**Success in This Role::**

* Deliver high\-impact Mac UI features that improve customer experience and product quality
* Strengthen the architecture and long\-term maintainability of the Mac UI codebase
* Help teams move faster through sound technical decisions, reusable patterns, and strong engineering practices
* Serve as a go\-to technical leader for complex UI and platform integration challenges
* Champion thoughtful adoption of modern development practices, including effective use of AI\-assisted engineering tools.
